{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Structured wool-blend blazer in deep charcoal grey (#36454F), tailored with a single-breasted notch lapel and slightly elongated length to balance standing posture, woven for structure.  
Crisp cotton-poplin button-down shirt in oatmeal beige (#D2C9A0), cut with a relaxed but defined shoulder and hem falling just below the blazer line.  
High-waisted wide-leg trousers in heavy matte black denim (#151515), straight-leg silhouette that flows smoothly while standing in a crowd, mid-weight twill fabric.  
Ankle boots in polished black leather (#0F0F0F), pointed toe with a 2 cm stacked heel for stability on uneven club floors, smooth grain finish.  
Slim gold-plated hoop earrings in 18k gold vermeil, small enough to stay secure during movement without drawing excessive attention.  
A structured clutch bag in matte black leather with a minimalist magnetic closure, sized to hold only essentials for an evening out.  

This outfit honors her request for a restrained and classic look despite the rock concert setting by anchoring the energy of the environment with timeless tailoring and neutral tones. The blazer and crisp shirt provide a polished silhouette that stands well in a crowd without feeling overwhelmed by the scene, while the dark denim trousers ground the ensemble in modern practicality. Warm artificial club lighting enhances the charcoal and gold accents, creating a sophisticated contrast that feels both intentional and effortless. Finally, the modest heel ensures comfort during hours of standing, aligning her personal need for stability with the event’s lively atmosphere."}
